title: Daily Activities and Hobbies
introduction: Talk about familiar routines and activities using short present-tense sentences.
definition: Talk about familiar routines and activities using short present-tense sentences.
rules: Talk about familiar routines and activities using short present-tense sentences.

examples.question: Complete: I ___ my teeth in the morning.
steps: Read the prompt and choose the word that fits.

examples.question: Complete: I ___ breakfast before school. (eat or eats)
steps: Read the prompt and choose the word that fits.

exercises.question: Complete: I ___ my teeth in the morning.
exercises.solution: Brushing teeth is part of keeping them clean.

exercises.question: Complete: I ___ breakfast before school. (eat or eats)
exercises.solution: Use the base verb with the subject I.

exercises.question: Complete: I like ___ books. (reading or read)
exercises.solution: After like, the -ing form can describe an activity you enjoy.

exercises.question: Complete: I ___ football with my friends. (play or plays)
exercises.solution: Use the base verb with I, without s.

exercises.question: Complete: I go to ___ at night. (bed or school)
exercises.solution: Going to bed is the usual activity before sleeping at night.

summary: Talk about familiar routines and activities using short present-tense sentences.
